notes.title: YYDS Road to Godhood 2.1.0 version update
notes.notes:
1.Level Structure Upgrade: The game transitions to a multi-camp mode, allowing players to challenge the next camp upon successfully completing one. This brings a deeper gaming experience to the players.

2.Introduction of New Characters: Ante joins the cast, providing players with additional strategic choices and possibilities for team combinations.

3.Enhanced Game Elements: Introducing a lucky wheel, talents, achievements, and an energy system, adding more elements and fun to the game.

4.Improved Sense of Satisfaction: Each level now permanently increases temporary attack speed by 0.08. Additional multi-projectile attributes are introduced, providing a more satisfying gaming experience.

5.Permanent Attribute System: Players can earn SP points by defeating monsters. These SP points can be consumed in the backpack interface to increase permanent attributes, adding a long-term development element to the game.

6.Gold Field Adjustments: Adjustments to gold drops from monster kills in the gold field, increasing the probability of dropping magic stones and enhancing the attractiveness and rewards of the gold field.

This update aims to enrich the game content, enhance players' sense of challenge and enjoyment, introduce new characters and systems to better meet player expectations.

notes.title: Late update notice
notes.notes:
First of all, I'm sorry, we didn't update the game content as scheduled.

Emergencies and more changes and additions to game settings have led to more recent versions of content that can be updated.



Next version update:

1. Add store and equipment system

2. Increase gold coin system

3. Add initial attributes and modify the overall numerical system

4. Adjust the level design to 1-21 levels, and increase the built-in play method of the level

5. Increase skill effect, and you can match different skill effects through different equipment

6. Add backpack system, you can use different props in the camp

7. Add the hero card system, which can change the character image through the hero card, and have a certain special effect at the same time

8. Adjust the display effect of some maps

9. Reset UI display, etc



There are many other fixes and updates, which are not listed here.

In general, this update has made major changes in all aspects except the original core gameplay of the game.

The production is being stepped up here, and the specific update time is not sure, but it should be within this month.



Finally, thank you for your attention to this game. I hope this game can bring you happiness.
